split.groups: closure of original exact lineage components plus all eligible content cosine>=0.995-1e-7 edges
split.assignment: SHA256(student-publisher-v1:17:minimum-original-row) first64bits modulo100: TRAIN<70, CALIBRATION<85, else EVALUATION
split.canonicalization: first source row per identical588view, equivalent inverse-view-multiplicity objective
split.failure: BLOCK; do not reseed or resample to force coverage
split.scope: internal grouped holdout from exposed publisher staging; not independent cross-domain test

model.output_semantics: logit0 publisher-normal; marginal logits1..7 publisher-anomaly latent bins, no family supervision

training.optimizer: existing AdamW-v1, betas0.9/0.999, epsilon1e-8, globalL2clip1, W-onlydecay0.0001
training.class_weights: inverse canonical TRAIN class frequency only
training.sampler: seeded group round-robin, each canonical TRAIN view once per epoch
training.checkpoint_selection: final fixed budget only; library best pointer is bookkeeping

evaluation.when: only on explicit user return; never automatic after training
evaluation.baseline: TRAIN majority/prior; metadata-only TRAIN window/body-state priors as shortcut control
evaluation.frozen_v2_reference: optional diagnostic only, disclose source pretraining overlap; never treat as unseen baseline
thresholds: maximize balanced accuracy on CALIBRATION only, highest threshold on ties
report: publisher label noise and same-source shift
evaluation.family_metrics: UNAVAILABLE unless separately verified; do not invent attack-family labels
evaluation.no_quality_claim: publisher-anomaly learning is not independently verified attack-intent improvement
